headline: NATO Convenes Extraordinary Meeting to Support Polish Border Security
summary: NATO ambassadors will hold an emergency North Atlantic Council meeting on Monday to discuss proposals for strengthening Poland's eastern border following recent airspace incursions.
why: NATO border security decisions in Eastern Europe directly influence defense procurement spending and geopolitical risk premiums across Western markets.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: NATO allies are preparing coordinated defense measures to reinforce Polish airspace and border defenses.
